primary_sources.page_provenance: Official archive page title and Japanese description identify MGS4, PS3; screenshots directly linked by page. US archive path redirects to this Japanese original-game archive.

physical_inspection.method: functions tools.view_image on each unmodified downloaded JPEG; original image pixels inspected, not generated composites

notes.01: 658x370. Close frontal three-quarter PS3 game rendering: elderly creased face, gray swept-back hair at nape, gray moustache, dark gray bandana. Black technological optic covers anatomical LEFT eye (viewer right in this frontal image); the opposite eye is bare. Fitted gray segmented suit, mesh fabric at inner sleeve, raised shoulder armor/padding, brown/tan harness, full dark gloves. Two-handed handgun aim. Exact handgun model not reliably identifiable from cropped muzzle view.
notes.03: 658x370. Side crouch beside rock, with opaque rock-pattern OctoCamo matching the surface. Hair/bandana and black optic visible. Torso harness, forearm/sleeve material, hip gear and a small blade are visible; exact knife model and gripping hand not established by this low-resolution shot.
notes.04: 658x370. Original gameplay rear three-quarter view: fitted dark suit, segmented shoulders/back, tan webbing crossing back with belt and pouches, gray nape hair and tied bandana tails. Rifle equipped in this screenshot, so pistol is one loadout rather than exclusive original-game equipment. Feet and much of legs cropped.
notes.key_art: 980x350 official archive hero face art: deep age lines, gray moustache, slicked-back gray hair/nape, dark bandana, close-fitting suit collar. Both eyes uncovered here; this identity art does not establish the Solid Eye-equipped gameplay loadout.

observed_costume_and_anatomy.face: Aged male, pronounced wrinkles, angular face, thick gray moustache, no full beard. Gray swept-back hair and longer nape.
observed_costume_and_anatomy.head: Dark gray bandana; visible knot/tails in rear view.
observed_costume_and_anatomy.anatomical_left_equipment: Solid Eye black electronic monocular is on anatomical LEFT eye in selected gameplay image01, viewer right from front. It is equipment, not an eyepatch injury or right-eye optic.
observed_costume_and_anatomy.body: Fitted gray/dark gray segmented OctoCamo with darker textured stretch/mesh sections and tan/brown webbing/harness. No loose generic fatigue jacket.
observed_costume_and_anatomy.hands: Full dark tactical gloves in selected close image; no prosthetic limb observed.
observed_costume_and_anatomy.belt_back: Tan webbing, belt and pouches observed in image04; exact pouch count or full holster placement not certified.
observed_costume_and_anatomy.legs_boots: Lower legs and feet not established by these selected images.
observed_costume_and_anatomy.camouflage: Image03 shows opaque material changing to a rock-like pattern; it does not prove transparent invisibility.

weapons.source_supported: A handgun is visually supported in01; a rifle loadout appears in04 and a small blade in03.
weapons.exact_model_status: UNRESOLVED: crop/resolution does not establish Mk.2 versus another MGS4 handgun; no pistol model is certified. Rifle/knife exact models and weapon handedness beyond visible two-handed aim are likewise unverified.
weapons.separate_hardware: Metal Gear Mk.II robot is not depicted in these refs; the similarly named pistol move does not provide a robot reference.

Gray agrees; raw snapshot does not encode nape length or swept-back shape.
Images establish aging wrinkles; no discrete canonical scar is certified from this source set. The moustache is visually prominent but absent from raw fields.
Pistol category agrees visually; exact Mk.2 model, tranquilizer mechanism, damage, timing and drowsy implementation are unsupported by these images. Profile labels this move adaptation.

All four are explicitly canonical=false, evidence=adaptation. No selected original still establishes these phase sequences or timings.
